sentences.en: Lincoln set out to abolish slavery in the United States.
sentences.zh: 林肯致力于废除美国的奴隶制。

sentences.en: That country broke off diplomatic relations with the United States.
sentences.zh: 那个国家与美国断绝了外交关系。

sentences.en: This is about as many as the United States has.
sentences.zh: 这大约是美国拥有的数量。
